description: React component implementing an ingestion interface for uploading documents, managing upload progress, persisting files, and orchestrating backend calls to generate a persona draft based on uploaded files.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Converts a byte count into a human-readable string with units.

methods.name: getFileExtLabel
methods.description: Returns the file extension label in uppercase or 'FILE' if none.

methods.name: getFileExt
methods.description: Extracts the file extension in lowercase from a filename.

methods.name: categoryLabel
methods.description: Returns a human-readable label for a given upload category.

methods.name: categoryTitle
methods.description: Returns a title string for a given upload category.

methods.name: categoryAccent
methods.description: Returns a color code associated with a category.

methods.name: acceptString
methods.description: Returns a string of accepted file extensions.

methods.name: validateFile
methods.description: Validates file type and size, returning validation result and reason if invalid.

methods.name: fileToStored
methods.description: Converts an UploadedPreview object to a StoredIngestionFile for persistence.

methods.name: storedToPreview
methods.description: Converts a StoredIngestionFile to an UploadedPreview for UI display.

methods.name: clampPct
methods.description: Clamps a number between 0 and 100, rounding to nearest integer.

methods.name: progressByFileSizes
methods.description: Calculates per-file upload progress percentages based on total loaded bytes.

methods.name: IngestionClient
methods.description: Main React component managing document upload, progress, persistence, and orchestration for persona generation.
